# Jest Gotchas

> Known Jest patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Use runTestsByPath for Next.js app-router test paths](run-tests-by-path-for-nextjs-app-router-test-paths.md): Positional paths containing route-group parentheses or dynamic-segment brackets are parsed as regex patterns and can report that an existing test file was not found. MEDIUM.

- [A hand-written DB fake that ignores a column makes a bug look like correct behaviour](db-fake-ignores-column-hides-bug.md): A fake models only the columns someone remembered, so a column it omits reads as null and the resulting test asserts the defect as expected behaviour -- the suite then stays green through both the bug and its fix. Mirror every column the real statement writes, throw on unmatched queries, and back enum/width/CHECK expectations with a migration integration test. HIGH.
